content_sections.heading: About Bharathiar University
content_sections.text: Bharathiar University is a State University in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu. Its letterhead describes it as accredited with "A++" Grade by NAAC and ranked 26th among Indian Universities by MoE-NIRF. These posts are in the project led by Dr. P. Shanmugam, Project Director and Associate Professor, Department of Economics, and the notice is forwarded by the Professor and Head of the Department of Economics.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There are 5 posts in total under the ICSSR project: 1 Research Assistant and 4 Field Investigators. The notice gives no category-wise break-up.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Each post has its own essential qualification and its own preference, as printed in the notice. The notice does not mention any experience requirement or age limit for either post. Candidates should check the official notification for the exact eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: Post Graduates in any Social Science discipline with a minimum of 55% marks
rows.preference: Preference will be given to candidates with M. Phil / Ph. D / NET

rows.essential_qualification: Graduates in any social science discipline with 55% marks
rows.preference: Preference will be given to candidates with four year graduation program

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Bharathiar University Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications for both posts are sent by email only. The notice does not mention any application form or postal submission. Prepare a detailed curriculum vitae. Keep copies of your certificates ready to attach. Send the curriculum vitae along with the certificate copies by email to [email protected] . Make sure the email is sent on or before 4 December 2026. Documents named in the notice: Detailed curriculum vitae Certificate copies Contact given in the notice: Dr. P. Shanmugam, Project Director, Associate Professor, Department of Economics, Bharathiar University, Coimbatore-641046, Tamil Nadu. Ph. No: 9442080966.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Bharathiar University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 vacancies: 1 Research Assistant post and 4 Field Investigator posts under the ICSSR project in the Department of Economics.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the Bharathiar University Research Assistant and Field Investigator posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must send their application by email on or before 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Bharathiar University Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: The Research Assistant must be a post graduate in any Social Science discipline with a minimum of 55% marks. Preference will be given to candidates with M. Phil / Ph. D / NET.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the Bharathiar University Field Investigator post?
faq.answer: The Field Investigator must be a graduate in any social science discipline with 55% marks. Preference will be given to candidates with four year graduation program.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the Research Assistant and Field Investigator posts?
faq.answer: The Research Assistant gets 37,000 pm/- and the Field Investigator gets 20,000 pm/-.

faq.question: Q6. How long are the Bharathiar University project posts?
faq.answer: The Research Assistant post is for 15 months and the Field Investigator posts are for 4 months, under the ICSSR-sanctioned project.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for Bharathiar University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Send your detailed curriculum vitae along with certificate copies by email to [email protected] on or before 4 December 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Which project are these Bharathiar University posts for?
faq.answer: The posts are under the ICSSR project titled "Conservation and Governance and Livelihood Transformation: The Impact of Tiger Reserve Policies on the Irula Community in Tamil Nadu", led by Dr. P. Shanmugam, Department of Economics.
